whatsappText: Hello Excello, I'd like to talk about a project.
seoDescription: Excello is a boutique architecture, interiors and design-and-build studio in Mount Lavinia, Colombo, guiding homeowners, hospitality teams and developers from an early idea to a buildable, useful place.
availabilityIntro: Compare currently available two- and three-bedroom residences by floor, size and standard price.
availabilityNote: Checked daily · Synced with the Unit Register
availabilityDisclaimer: Availability and prices are indicative and subject to confirmation at reservation. Standard prices are calculated at LKR 40,000 per sq.ft. Promotional or negotiated rates may differ.
availabilityCtaText: Ask about unit orientation, payment options, floor plans or arrange a project consultation.
calcHeading: Plan with clarity before you build.
calcIntro: Create an indicative early-stage construction budget from your project type, land extent, room programme and material choices.
calcAreaNote: Construction area is estimated from your room programme. Land extent is captured for context and does not change the estimate unless configured.
calcDisclaimer: This is an indicative early-stage estimate only, not a formal quotation. Final construction costs depend on design, site conditions, specification, approvals and prevailing market rates. Contact Excello for a detailed proposal.
